Practice form 3. Asha is editing a short report about a river survey.

Which option is an independent clause?
A) The volunteers completed the survey.
B) Because the volunteers completed the survey
C) Although the survey was complete
D) When the volunteers arrived

options.A: The volunteers completed the survey.
options.B: Because the volunteers completed the survey

questions.explanation: The correct choice directly applies the target skill: 识别独立分句与从属分句.
